findings.evidence: `Series.lean:174` proves `completionLaurentCoeff_ext_iff`; `Basic.lean:70` supplies the coefficient bridge, while lines 165–169 redo injectivity and `HahnSeries.ext` directly.
findings.fix: After applying `P.completionEmbedding.injective`, use `P.completionLaurentCoeff_ext_iff hP ht` and discharge each coefficient with `completionLaurentCoeff_completionEmbedding`.
findings.issue: `laurentSeriesExpansion_ext_iff` repeats the `HahnSeries.ext` argument already encapsulated by `completionLaurentCoeff_ext_iff`.

findings.evidence: `Series.lean:154–164` contains the identical Hahn-series scalar bridge and lines 204–205 specialize it at `-1`; `Basic.lean:192–194` already proves that this specialization composed with `completionEmbedding` equals `residue`.
findings.fix: Define it as `(P.completionResidue hP ht).comp P.completionEmbedding.toLinearMap` and derive `residue_apply` from the completed apply/embedding lemmas.
findings.issue: `residue` rebuilds the same coefficientwise linear-map bridge as `completionLaurentCoeff`, despite being the restriction of `completionResidue` along the completion embedding.

summary: Two additions rederive structure already provided earlier in the same API instead of composing the completed coefficient and residue maps.
